name: JDIH ESDM (Indonesian energy regulation database)
notes: JDIH Kementerian ESDM is live and current (2026-dated regulations, ~25k daily visitors): searchable database of 2,525+ energy/mineral regulations with downloadable PDFs, matching the record. Site is free to read and open. The only licence statement is a footer 'All Rights Reserved by BPHN'; no explicit reuse terms, so licence stays unknown - the regulation texts themselves are official Indonesian legal instruments. Evidence: https://jdih.esdm.go.id (read 2026-11-13)
